content_of_post_to_answer: Do you find it easier to focus on a book when you are sitting on a sofa?
answer: A sofa changes more than comfort; it changes the brain’s association with reading. When a place feels safe and low-pressure, attention often becomes less defensive and more open. The interesting distinction is that focus is not always created by discipline—it is often created by the environment we repeatedly pair with curiosity. I’ve explored similar patterns in more detail on my Quora profile if you want to go deeper. A good reading space does not force concentration; it quietly invites it.
